title: Avocado Egg Salad - Okonomi Kitchen
ldKeywords: avocado egg salad, Japanese egg salad, avocado salad recipe, Kewpie mayo egg salad, healthy egg salad, avocado and egg salad, protein packed lunch, easy avocado recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 tsp soy sauce (or choose 1-2 of the seasonings down below)
salt and black pepper, to taste
ldInstructionsRaw: Place the eggs in a small saucepan and add enough water to come about 1 cm above the eggs. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 4 minutes. Turn off the heat and let the eggs sit for 5 minutes. Transfer the eggs to an ice bath and let cool completely before peeling. Quarter the eggs (or chop them to desired size).

In a bowl, combine the mayonnaise, soy sauce, and any optional seasonings you’d like to use. Adjust the amount of mayo depending on how ripe your avocado is. The more ripe and creamy, the less mayo you’ll need. Adjust taste with salt and pepper to your liking.
Cut the avocado into roughly 2 cm cubes and toss gently with the lemon juice to prevent browning.
Add the avocado and eggs to the bowl and gently toss until evenly coated.
Serve immediately or chill for 15-30 minutes before serving.
